adds.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia; Australia section)
adds.summary: Queensland placement policy: the 2009 Corrective Services procedure on transgender prisoners was assessed as largely ineffective (Jenny Samiec, Queensland Law Student Review 2009). Replacement oversight came via the Inspector of Detention Services Act 2022 (fully in force 2023), whose August 2023 inspection standards for Queensland prisons and youth detention centres direct that transgender and intersex prisoners are generally to be admitted to facilities corresponding to their lived or experienced gender. Staff still hold discretion at admission, and only transgender people who have undergone sexual reassignment surgery are excluded from that process - so Queensland placement is identity-based with a discretionary admission caveat and a surgery exception.

records.note: Queensland is the only state with placement detail found within budget (2023 standards: lived/experienced-gender placement with staff-discretion and surgery-exception caveats). No data surfaced for other states/territories, or on solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners, within the 2-fetch limit.

adds.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia; New Zealand section)
adds.summary: New Zealand: citing Dalzell, Pang & Broemdal 2024 (Australian & New Zealand Journal of Psychiatry, 'Gender affirmation and mental health in prison'), the article reports that trans people in New Zealand prisons are more likely to have prior experience of abuse and show a higher rate of incarceration, and that the NZ government has declared support for gender-affirming healthcare and gender-affirming clothing for incarcerated persons. No placement rule (birth-sex vs identity housing), special unit, or solitary/segregation practice for New Zealand is described.

records.note: no prison-housing placement data found for NZ within budget - only gender-affirming-care policy support and a 2024 study on trans prisoners; no documentation of solitary/segregation practice or documented trans-prisoner housing cases surfaced.
